baseline_prompt_en: An intact pain au chocolat rests on a plain plate on a clean bakery counter. The plate is cream colored, and the counter stays quiet so the food carries the image. A modest view from above the counter includes the pastry's top and side. Natural daylight gives the baked surface an ordinary, appetizing presence.
